chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the
spiritual_reading:
Everything in the whole order of created things, in what is higher and what is lower, is arranged according to the form of a person; and a person, even in outward life, is formed according to the order of that whole, because every lesser recipient is patterned from the greater so that influx may descend and return in an image.

In the highest degree of a person is what first receives and presents the outer coverings of life, as the initial yield of all that can be expressed. From the first descent of that highest degree to the region where love begins to rule as a center, there is an ordered series of general receiving levels through which higher things are held distinct and then let down. The central love itself is the governing turning of life, by which all things are kept in relation and motion according to end. From that center downward into the lower interiors there is the intermediate region where spiritual activity is tempered into natural operation, as higher influences are carried toward the ultimate plane. The specifically active power of a person, by which truth is implanted into use, is the image of the outermost plane itself. Beneath the lower interiors down to the generative powers is an image of the full complex of ultimates in their threefold arrangement. The fixed supporting powers that enable standing in life are an image of the outermost boundary where ultimate resistance and permission are set. The most external sensory base is an image of the general ultimate plane on which those supporting powers rest, together with the complete set of fixed restraints that hold what is lowest in order. The power of ardent desire in a person is the receptacle of love in its most operative form. The obscuring and resistant element of the proprium is the receptacle of denial and mere appearance. The circulating life of truth in a person is the receptacle of understanding.

In this way the lesser human form answers to the greater order in its receiving levels, in its arrangements, in its elevations of state, in its outer boundaries, and in its containing forms, as has already been made manifest.

There are also five principal administrations in the outermost region of life, and a sufficient set of operative powers from the Divine is set over them.

In the first and highest guarding administration, which is governed by the power that preserves illumination, there is rule at the boundary of all outward works, and its jurisdiction extends over the complete triad of higher degrees. Beneath it are subordinate guards who serve the sovereign of spiritual nobility.

The second guarding administration is governed by that sovereign of spiritual nobility, and its own jurisdiction extends over the full series of general receiving levels that lie beneath it.

The third guarding administration is governed by the power of unyielding truth, whose jurisdiction extends from the general receiving level down into the ultimate plane. By that authority it strengthens the general compass of life and the intermediate region where spiritual things are rendered active in the natural, together with the fourfold set of subordinate planes appointed within the ultimate.

The fourth guarding administration is governed by the power of manifested Divine truth, and it rules the threefold turning operations by which life is carried through its degrees. Its jurisdiction lies over the full complex of ultimates arranged in three, resting upon the ultimate supporter.

The fifth guarding administration is governed by the ultimate supporter itself, and by its authority it presides over the general ultimate plane on which life stands, together with the complete set of fixed restraints that hold the lowest things in connection.

Disturbance has arisen in these five guarding administrations at various times.

In the administration that preserves illumination, evil endeavored to surge upward toward the represented presence of Divine influx; but it was shut out from that higher reception, and it fell back into its own disgrace.

In the administration of spiritual nobility there was a violent shaking of state and an act of betrayal; and the guards who rose at that time, and those who were sent down for correction, brought the insurgent things down until they were humbled.

In the administration of unyielding truth, perverted beginnings of life were let down into the ultimate plane, and from them an external life was formed, separate from inner order.

In the administration of manifested Divine truth there was an upheaval in the threefold ultimates above the ultimate supporter. The way of ascent was blocked for the threefold circulating operations that should have carried life upward: one by volatile persuasion, one by falsified understanding, and one by perverted love.

In the administration of the ultimate supporter, the fixed restraints beneath were exposed, and they strained against their bonds; and there was a great shaking in that lowest boundary.

There is also the instruction of wisdom that circulates through a person, according to the likeness of pure wisdom that continually descends into lower things and ascends again, above and below, through the whole extent of life.

And there are love and joy, faith and truth, in which a person ought to live; these are like two chief means of conveyance for the living mind. By them the inner person is lifted up and released; and by them it rises from the lowest confusions and arrives at the highest states.

Understand further that within external life there are four distinct planes, and within the life of those four planes there are rulers in innumerable series, each completing the full process in its own kind.

The first plane is the highest region of life; and its seven ruling faculties there are the complete set of perceptions and discriminations by which truth is received: the paired perception that admits light, the paired perception that admits teaching, the paired perception that admits inward notice, and the faculty that admits appropriation.

The second plane is the region from that highest down through the whole upper natural; and its seven ruling faculties are operative forms analogous to those above: the paired powers for doing that answer to the paired powers for receiving teaching; the paired nurturing affections that answer to inward notice; the paired interior perceptions of love; and the mediating faculty by which nourishment is taken in, answering to appropriation.

In the third plane there are seven ruling functions of the interior natural: the storing and moderating element, the breathing and enlivening element, the balancing and resisting element, the ardent desiring element, the separating and rejecting element, and the paired powers of purification and regulation.

In the fourth plane below there are another seven ruling functions of like kind: the paired bases of ultimate support, the paired generative powers, the paired stabilizing powers of conjunction, and the one productive power from which interior truths go forth in potency and by which forms are propagated.

There is also the full organization of truths in their completeness, arranged as a single whole in the higher general compass of life. They are conjoined and held together within the revolving government of the whole, and they are established there as fixed determinations and implanted orders; and they are appointed as leading principles within the general knowledges beneath the ultimate heaven of higher knowledges, so that the beginnings and the endings of every process may be found, and the chain of order traced from first to last.

These same full organizations of truth appear, in order and number, throughout a person from highest to lowest. In the highest reception is the beginning of governing truth. In the first descent and the first supporting strength is the next determination. In the paired operative powers is the following. In the upper natural as a whole is the next. In the central appropriation of life is the next. In the ordered arrangement of lower natural functions is the next. In the straight support of connection and the lower interior functions is the next. In the generative region is the next. In the stabilizing powers of conjunction is the next. In the bending powers that enable kneeling submission is the next. In the fixed supporting powers of walking life is the next. And in the most external sensory base is the final.

They are also distributed in the person in a lateral arrangement, as though turned and bent, to the pattern of complete order. They are arranged opposite each other, beginning paired with ending, as they are in the governing revolution of the whole.

They are numbered according to the full body of life and all its particular functions. They are said to be turned and bent and spread out because, from the highest down to the middle, six are counted on one side, and another six on the other.

The six on the right are these: in the rightmost intellectual boundary is the first governing truth; in the right supporting strength is the next; in the right operative power is the next; in the right encompassing defense is the next; in the appropriation of life is the next; and in the right side of generative activity is the next.

Conversely the other six on the left rise from the middle toward the highest: in the left balancing support is the next; in the left encompassing defense is the next; in the left nurturing affection together with the left regulating power is the next; in the left turning of operation is the next; in the left supporting strength is the next; and in the leftmost intellectual boundary is the final. Thus the former of the human form appointed them, set them in order, and arranged them each against its companion, beginning paired with ending.

Understand also that there are many powers in a person, set as indwelling governors within the house of life. They are innumerable in their kinds and functions, distributed and fixed in their quarters according to their dwelling-places; and the ordered regions of their dwelling are beyond counting in the natural thought.

When these ruling forces begin to creep and move within a person, they can come into collision. Then they beset each other and strive for dominion, and disorder is kindled within. When the person’s outward life is ending, these disordered forces break forth from the unity of the person’s life and produce burning and corrupt states in the outermost degree. Either they have already made the interiors sick by their hidden conflict, or they manifest themselves outwardly in visible disorders. At first such disorders are pressed so that their falsities and evils are discharged and the foulness is emptied out, until what is corrupt is forced away from the place of outbreak. Afterwards the outer plane is closed again, and the person is restored and comes into relief in the regions where the disorder had emerged.

fills.notes: The active/prolific side of the body is being mapped to the ultimate plane (“great earth”), i.e., the plane where truth is implanted into use; this is the ‘male’ correspondence in this substrate register.

The correspondential structure requires a mediating rank: subordinate guards/watchers stationed ‘below’ the highest keeper, functioning as appointed ministers who serve the next sovereignty (King of Honour). A bare “are” would be too thin; an appointment/ministration verb matches the five-watch administration schema.

Keeps the fixed five-watch formula: ‘the Nth watch, of which X is master, his authority …’. The agent here must be the Adamant as unyielding truth, whose jurisdiction extends downward through lower degrees.

In this disturbance the ‘watchers who had arisen’ must first resist/contain the treachery before the sent ones descend to abase it. A firmness/withstand verb fits the spiritual sense: guards rise, oppose, then corrective descent humbles.
The zodiac signs are said to be ‘interlocked and bound’ on the turning wheel; the next predicate must express established position before “fixed, and planted.”
They are ‘appointed and made leaders’—the missing phrase should name their function as governing principles within the sphere’s order (not moral exhortation).
The point is that within this orderly binding one can discern beginnings; hence ‘head of each (sign/process)’ in the substrate’s structural idiom.
Pairs with “head” and “tail” to state the full chain of order (beginning/end), matching the spiritual translation’s ‘chain of order traced from first to last.’
Completes the clause “as they occur on the wheel … up”: the lateral arrangement in the body matches the zodiacal order ‘where they come up’ (i.e., their rising/appearance on the wheel).
The left-side series is counted ‘from its hip to its head’; the first left member therefore is located at the hip-region (corresponding to Libra in the lateral scheme).

After ‘beset and destroy one another’ the next effect is the ignition of inner turmoil; this matches the spiritual sense (‘disorder is kindled within’) and keeps the impersonal, process-description register.

The following clause speaks of eruption at death; the lacuna must mark the terminal condition (‘when it is time…’) rather than introduce exhortation. The surviving letters t/il constrain toward “time”.

The squeezing/discharge sequence requires a completion of evacuation before ‘suppuration forced out’ and then closure/healing. This matches the spiritual sense: falsities/evils discharged until the corrupt is forced away.

assessment: Most gaps are tightly constrained by the chapter’s fixed five-watch schema and the reiterated ‘head/tail’ order logic of the zodiac section. The remaining restorations (¶6, ¶13, ¶33, ¶39) are less philologically determinate but are correspondentially constrained: they must express mediation/ministration (¶6), resistance then humiliation (¶13), zodiacal rising/occurrence (¶33), and the sequence of inner conflict → terminal eruption → evacuation → closure (¶39).
